name: Playcraft
description: Automate every Google Play Store publishing task — store listings, ASO, release notes, policy declarations, and screenshot copy. Built by an Android developer who has shipped 20+ apps.
longDescription:
Ships **5 skills**, **4 agents** and **6 commands**.

- **Skills** (5): `ai-content-declarations` (How to declare AI-generated content on Google Play (2025–2026 requirement)), `closed-testing` (Google Play closed testing requirements for new developer accounts (2024–2026)), `developer-identity-th` (Developer identity verification for Thailand-based Google Play developers), `financial-declarations` (How to complete financial features declarations on Google Play), `play-policy-2026` (Google Play Developer Policy key rules for 2025–2026 submissions)
- **Agents** (4): `aso-agent` (Keyword research and density analysis agent for Google Play ASO), `listing-writer` (Specialist agent for writing Play Store titles, short descriptions, and full descriptions), `locale-agent` (Localization agent for Play Store listings — translates and adapts content per locale), `policy-checker` (Google Play Developer Policy compliance agent)
- **Commands** (6): `aso-audit` (Run a full ASO audit — scores your title, short desc, and full description out of 30, with…), `declarations` (Generate all required Play Console policy declarations — data safety, financial features, AI content, families, and identity verification…), `release-notes` (Write Play Store release notes (what's new) for an app update), `screenshots` (Write captions (~30 chars), alt text, and slot recommendations for up to 8 Play Store screenshots), `setup` (Show your current PlayCraft developer config and how to update it), `store-listing` (Generate a complete Play Store listing — title, short description, and full description with character limit checks and…)

Installs with `claude plugin install playcraft@claude-community` from `SUDARSHANCHAUDHARI/PlayCraft`.
